title: Turkish-Style Grilled Haddock
description: A flavorful and healthy seafood dish inspired by Turkish cuisine, featuring haddock grilled to perfection with a hint of joyful spices.

ingredients.name: Turkish spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of paprika, garlic, and cumin

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Rinse the haddock fillets under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the Turkish spices and olive oil.
Brush the spice mixture evenly onto both sides of the haddock fillets.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the haddock for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through and flaky.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Let the fish rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
